events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe 32nd
angles.copy: 32 years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. Still sounding as massive today.

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock 57th
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The original festival that changed everything.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: This day marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: 49 years ago today, we lost the one and only King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: This day marks 56 years since the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, we lost a true musical pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's legacy continues to inspire guitarists and music lovers worldwide. Still sounds phenomenal.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road 57th
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' hit the streets. An album that defined a generation, and still sounds as fresh today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Bday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' sound is unmistakable. Still rocking it.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Bday
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! The voice of a generation, still bringing the swagger and those unmistakable vocals.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally, a timeless message of peace.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod. It completely changed how we listened to music, fitting a thousand songs in your pocket. A true tech icon.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film's premiere.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007, from 'Dr. No' to the latest blockbusters. Licence to thrill, every time.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Bday Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. A true legend.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Bday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles released their ambitious 'White Album'. A double album masterpiece that showcased their incredible range.
